notes: Fixed a harvest crash ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'get') in the contract-renewals fetch, discovered by testing with a second Active IQ account that has zero accessible systems and no watchlists. Found and fixed 5 more instances of the same .get(key, default)-doesn't-apply-to-explicit-None bug across customers/sites/sustainability/osVersions parsing. Also documented (via live schema introspection) that the GraphQL 'watchlists' query field does not exist in the current API — the fallback code is harmless dead weight, not a functional path; REST discovery is the only channel that has ever worked.
